tasks.description: GRANT-3. `all`, or the Task types the `tasks` entry raises whose Tasks a credential issued for this grant covers (TASK-6), each one the Worker declares. An empty list covers none.

actions.description: GRANT-3. `all`, or the Actions the `actions` entry accepts that a credential issued for this grant covers (ACT-22), each one the Worker declares. An empty list covers none.

events.description: GRANT-3. `all`, or the event types the `events` entry publishes that a credential issued for this grant covers (SUB-4), each one the Worker declares. An empty list covers none.

credential.description: GRANT-4, GRANT-5. The credential the owner issued for this grant, presented by REG-3. Present on creation and on a rotation, and only then: the owner keeps no copy it could answer again.

title: Grant receipt
description: GRANT-4, GRANT-5. What applying a grant answers: the grant as applied, and the credential issued for it where this call issued one.
